openDates.label: Christmas
openDates.note: Arrive any day through Dec 24, leave by Dec 27. No check-in on Dec 25.

note: openDates: the stays still open, kept by the owner. Each drops off the day after its from date (after lastArrival, if it has one). An empty list means waitlist only. midweekNights: the open nights behind 'Midweek nights are open too' (first and last night of each run); the planner uses them to tell whether its dates are open. noCheckIn: no booking link ever starts on these days. Set active to false when the next year opens. Sign-ups are tagged waitlist-<nextYear>.
